baski_dosyasi.bicim: 3mf (Bambu Studio projesi; TEK PLATE, IKI PARCA yan yana — multi-plate DEGIL). different_settings_to_system DOLU (17 anahtar); gomulu ayarlar gercek slice ile toolpath'e ulastigi dogrulandi (17/17 gcode basliginda eslesti).
baski_dosyasi.icerik: IKI PARCA TEK TABLADA (ayni plate, 44802 ucgen = 21816 + 22986): (1) disli-1 O20.59 x 6.00 mm, 1421.4 mm3 — plate merkezi X=155, Y=160; (2) disli-2 O16.20 x 12.91 mm, 1007.0 mm3 — plate merkezi X=195, Y=160. Merkez-merkez 40.00 mm. Ikisi de min_z=0, disli ekseni = Z.
baski_dosyasi.yazici: Bambu Lab H2D 0.4 nozzle — Textured PEI Plate (ASA 100C tabla; varsayilan Cool Plate ASA'yi reddediyor)
baski_dosyasi.process: PRUVO ASA Disli 0.12mm @BBL H2D (sistem tabani: 0.12mm Fine @BBL H2D, inherits_group ile beyan edildi)
baski_dosyasi.filament: Bambu ASA @BBL H2D 0.4 nozzle (GFB01) — 270C nozul / 100C tabla, fan %10-35 (ASA icin DUSUK, sistem degeri korundu), ilk 3 katman fan kapali, hava filtresi acik
baski_dosyasi.ayar: katman 0.12mm (ilk 0.20mm); 4 duvar; %80 cubic dolgu; ust 9 / alt 7 kabuk; DESTEK YOK; brim outer_only 8mm; precise_outer_wall acik; reduce_crossing_wall acik. YAVAS (Okan talimati + disli hassasiyeti): dis duvar 30 mm/s (sistem 60), ic duvar 60 (120), ilk katman 25 (40), ust yuzey 80 (150), solid dolgu 100 (150), seyrek dolgu 80 (100), bosluk dolgu 40 (50), gezinme 350 (500), dis duvar ivme 1000 (2000).
baski_dosyasi.yon: Tasarimcinin/kaynagin baski yonu KORUNDU: disli DUZLEMI tablaya paralel (disli ekseni = Z), min_z = 0. Boylece her katman dislinin tam kesiti olur, dis kokleri katman-arasi cekmeye DEGIL duzlem-ici yuke calisir. Z kesiti 0..6mm boyunca sabit -> cikinti yok, destek gereksiz.
baski_dosyasi.yapisma: ASA carpilmaya yatkin -> 8mm outer_only brim (Okan talimati). RAFT DEGIL: taban tam duz ve genis (sabit kesit), raft press-fit parcanin alt yuzunu ve olcusunu bozardi.
baski_dosyasi.dogrulama: GERCEK SLICE (birlesik dosya, iki parca birlikte). (1) Kanonik H2D 3mf headless dilimlenemiyor — 'No valid nozzle found' (cift nozul); KUSUR DEGIL, H2D'nin bilinen CLI sinirlamasi. (2) Es-degerde TEK nozullu kardes H2S 0.4 ikizi ile (YALNIZ makine anahtarlari degistirildi; process+filament birebir korundu) HICBIR --load-settings VERILMEDEN dilimlendi: return_code 0 'Success.', warning_message BOS. 107 katman, max_z 12.92 mm, model baski suresi 29dk44sn (toplam tahmin 30dk03sn), 2.62 g ASA (GFB01), triangle_count 44802 = iki mesh'in TAM toplami -> iki parca da dilimlendi. Brim URETILDI (FEATURE: Brim, 2759.7 mm). DESTEK YOK: hicbir support FEATURE'i uretilmedi, enable_support=0. Tabla M190 S100, gomulu nozzle_temperature 270 / hot_plate_temp 100. Gomulu 17 override'in 17'si gcode basliginda birebir cikti. 'Floating vertical shell' 149.1 mm = toplam ekstruzyonun %0.35'i (helis disi dibi artefakti, destek gerektirmiyor).
baski_dosyasi.kaynak_baski_notu: Tasarimci (Thingiverse thing:7015301): "Printed out of ABS on an Ender 3 Pro. 0.16mm layer height. Press fits into the spline." Press-fit oldugu icin XY olcu hassasiyeti kritik -> precise_outer_wall acik, XY telafisi (xy_hole/contour_compensation) OLCUM olmadan DEGISTIRILMEDI (sistem 0).
baski_dosyasi.arac: BambuStudio CLI 02.08.00.50 (birlestirme + round-trip + gercek slice dogrulamasi)
baski_dosyasi.uyari_kaynak_dosya: ✅ KARAR VERILDI (Okan, 12 Agu 2026) — onceki 'karar bekliyor / BASILMAZ-SATILMAZ' notu GECERSIZ. Teknik gercek degismedi: Okan'in sagladigi 'Mercedes SL R129 Headrest Height Adjustment.stl' (sha1 c67a5afd...) IKI govde iceriyordu: (1) Ø20.59x6.00mm, 1421.4 mm3 disli = Drive arsivindeki kayitli kaynak '7015301--r129headrest25degreehelixgear.stl' (1422.1 mm3) ile AYNI parca (90 derece dondurulmus + yeniden meshlenmis); (2) Ø16.20x12.91mm, 1007.0 mm3 ikinci disli — thing:7015301'de boyle bir dosya YOK. Okan dosyayi kendisi verdigi ve ikisinin de kullanilmasini soyledigi icin HER IKISI de ASA kanonik 3mf'e islendi. Arsiv dosyalari R2+Drive'da hala duruyor: '--kaynak-okan-indirme-2parca.stl' (ham 2 govdeli) ve '--ikinci-parca-lisans-karari-bekliyor.stl' (izole 2. govde; ADI TARIHSEL, karar artik VERILDI).
baski_dosyasi.set: 🔴 URUN IKI PARCALI SET — Okan 12 Agu 2026'da NET karar verdi: kaynak STL'i BIZZAT KENDISI sagladi ve iki dislinin de kullanilmasina/kataloga girmesine karar verdi; LISANS SORGUSU KAPANDI, yeniden acilmaz. KANONIK TESLIMAT = TEK BIRLESIK DOSYA: bu blogun ust duzey alanlari (baski_dosyasi.r2 / .drive / icerik / sha1 / boyut_bayt) ARTIK IKI DISLIYI TEK PLATE'te tasiyan BIRLESIK 3mf'i anlatir (disli-1 Ø20.59 x 6.00 mm + disli-2 Ø16.20 x 12.91 mm). Musteriye bu TEK dosya verilir/basilir. Eski TEKIL dosyalar (disli-1 tek, disli-2 tek, ham 2 govdeli kaynak STL) R2/Drive'da SILINMEDI ama artik guncel teslimat DEGIL — hepsi `baski_dosyasi.arsiv` altindadir.
baski_dosyasi.yerlesim: Merkez-merkez 40.00 mm (tabla merkezi 175,160 etrafinda simetrik). CAKISMA YOK — gercek toolpath'ten olculdu: ilk katman (brim dahil) disli-1 X[137.52..172.43], disli-2 X[179.72..210.28] -> aradaki TEMIZ BOSLUK 7.29 mm. Govde-govde bosluk 21.61 mm. disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.bicim: 3mf (Bambu Studio projesi; different_settings_to_system DOLU — 17 anahtar, IKI YONLU kabul testiyle dogrulandi: beyan == olcum, yalan beyan 0 / eksik beyan 0)
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.icerik: TEK govde: Ø16.20 x 12.91 mm, 1007.0 mm3, 22986 ucgen, manifold (kenar ihlali 0; Bambu mesh_stat edges_fixed=0 degenerate=0 reversed=0). Govde iki bolgeli: z 0-6.9 mm helis disli (Ø16.20), z 6.9-12.91 mm daha dar kovan/mil. Kardes disliden (Ø20.59x6.00) DAHA UZUN ve DAHA DAR.
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.yazici: Bambu Lab H2D 0.4 nozzle — Textured PEI Plate (ASA 100C tabla; varsayilan Cool Plate ile slice REDDEDILIYOR: olculdu, cikis kodu 195)
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.process: PRUVO ASA Disli 0.12mm @BBL H2D (sistem tabani: 0.12mm Fine @BBL H2D, inherits_group ile beyan edildi)
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.filament: Bambu ASA @BBL H2D 0.4 nozzle (GFB01) — 270C nozul / 100C tabla, fan %10-35, ilk 3 katman fan kapali, hava filtresi acik
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.ayar: Kardes disliyle AYNI set: katman 0.12mm (ilk 0.20mm); 4 duvar; %80 cubic dolgu; ust 9 / alt 7 kabuk; DESTEK YOK; brim outer_only 8mm; precise_outer_wall acik; reduce_crossing_wall acik. YAVAS (Okan talimati): dis duvar 30 mm/s (sistem 60), ic duvar 60 (120), ilk katman 25 (40), ust yuzey 80 (150), solid dolgu 100 (150), seyrek dolgu 80 (100), bosluk dolgu 40 (50), gezinme 350 (500), dis duvar ivme 1000 (2000).
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.yon: Kaynak dosyadaki yon KORUNDU (min_z = 0, disli ekseni = Z) — kardesten KOR KOPYA DEGIL, bu govdenin kendi geometrisiyle OLCULDU: Z yukari iken 45 dereceden dik cikinti alani 0.00 mm2 ve tabla disinda asagi bakan yuzey 0.00 mm2 (kesit yukari dogru yalniz daralir) -> destek gereksiz. X ya da Y yukari olsaydi 252 mm2 destek gerektiren cikinti cikardi. Tabla temasi z=0 duzleminde 128.20 mm2 (disli alt yuzu).
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.yapisma: 8 mm outer_only brim. GENISLIK OLCUMLE SECILDI (kardesten devralinmadi): ilk katman kontur uzunlugu 114.11 mm, tabla temasi 128.20 mm2 (kardesin ~yarisi) ama parca 12.91 mm ile 2,15 kat daha uzun; 8 mm brim ~560 mm2 ek yapisma (parca tabaninin ~4,4 kati) verir ve etkin taban capini Ø32 mm'ye cikarir (yukseklik/taban orani 0,40) -> yeterli. Daha genis brim disli disi diplerinden temizlemeyi zorlastirirdi. RAFT DEGIL: taban duz, raft press-fit olcusunu bozardi.
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.dogrulama: GERCEK SLICE. (1) Kanonik H2D 3mf headless dilimlenemiyor — olculdu, cikis kodu 156 (cift nozul); bu KUSUR DEGIL, H2D projelerinin CLI sinirlamasi. (2) Es-degerde TEK nozullu kardes H2S 0.4 ile AYNI 17 override'la slice: 107 katman, max_z 12.92 mm, model baski suresi 17dk32sn (makine acilis kalibrasyonu dahil toplam tahmin 35dk01sn), 1.13 g ASA, 447.49 mm filament, brim URETILDI (FEATURE: Brim), destek extrusion YOK (support_used=false), tabla M190 S100. (3) GOMULU AYAR KANITI: ayni process ile uretilen H2S ikiz 3mf HICBIR --load-settings VERILMEDEN dilimlendi; gcode basliginda 21 anahtarin 21'i gomulu degerle birebir cikti -> gomulu ayarlar gercekten toolpath'e ulasiyor. (4) Tek uyari 'bed_temperature_too_high_than_filament' — BIZIM override'lardan DEGIL: Bambu'nun kendi ASA profili hic dokunulmadan da ayni uyariyi veriyor (ASA vitrifikasyon 100C = onerilen tabla 100C); taban kosumuyla ATFEDILDI.
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.kaynak_baski_notu: Bu govde thing:7015301 dosya listesinde YOK; kaynak tasarimcinin ayri bir baski notu da yok. Kardes disliyle ayni araca ayni mekanizmada girdigi ve ayni press-fit sinifinda oldugu icin XY telafisi (xy_hole/contour_compensation) OLCUM olmadan DEGISTIRILMEDI (sistem 0), precise_outer_wall acik.
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.makine_profili_notu: Makine profilinin GERCEK uretim gcode'lari ayri 'template ...' dosyalarindadir (H2D acilis gcode'u 16.480 bayt); CLI bu overlay'i kendiliginden birlestirmiyor, ELLE birlestirildi -> 3mf gercek H2D acilis/kapanis/katman/filament-degisim gcode'unu tasiyor. NOT: kardes dosya (1. disli) bu birlestirme YAPILMADAN uretilmisti, onda iskelet gcode + printable_height 100 var; fark bilinerek kayda gecirildi.
disli_2_tekil_olcum_kaydi.durum: 🔁 ARSIV — bu parca artik AYRI dosya olarak teslim edilmiyor; yukaridaki BIRLESIK 3mf'in icinde, ayni plate'te (merkez X=195, Y=160) yer aliyor. Asagidaki olcum ve gerekceler (yon, brim genisligi, mesh saglik) GECERLIDIR ve birlesik dosyada AYNEN korunmustur.

toyota-tacoma-kasa-rayi-bisiklet-tutucus.baski: When printing the mounting for please print in a orientation that suits your needs, however support material will be required.

toyota-kaput-alti-panel-pimi.baski: Be sure to print this with PETG or TPU. PLA and ABS seem to break

toyota-4runner-arka-kamera-tutucusu.baski: Given it's made to be left in the car in all conditions, I'd highly recommend PETG or ABS as I fear PLA will melt in the heat.

toyota-tundra-arka-cam-kamera-tutucusu.baski: I personally recommend using alien tape to affix the camera to the clip/mount because I find it grabs onto PETG very well.

toyota-corolla-navigasyon-telefon-tutucu.baski: It's a side-window hot air nozzle with a mount bracket for navigator, camera, phone etc.

toyota-4runner-5-nesil-bardaklik-daralti.baski: Nothing special print wise, no supports needed.

toyota-65-hoparlor-montaj-adaptoru.baski: The membrane holes model can be printed without supports. The through hole version will likely need supports.

toyota-tacoma-2018-konsol-eklentisi.baski: I always recommend PetG for anything that will be left inside a vehicle.

toyota-camry-bardaklik-telefon-tutucusu.baski: It is made out of PLA filament.

toyota-4runner-5-nesil-arka-kamera-tutuc.baski: Recommended to print with a resin printer, FDM is theoretically possible but awkward with supports. Almost any material would be viable though PLA is obviously dangerous in a hot car.

mr2-motor-kaputu-ubuk-klipsi.baski: Use only material with a glas transition temperature of over 100°C / 212°F like ABS!

toyota-sw20-mr2-k-ll-k-bardakl-k.baski: be sure to print in ASA, ABS, or at least PETG so it doesn't melt

motor-bujisi-bo-luk-adapt-r-3mm-led-i-in.baski: I found that for me it worked best to mechanically work on the spark plugs if I printed them in ABS. Drilling and grinding on either ABS or PLA is best done with care but PLA will be softer and melt at a lower temperature.

toyota-tacoma-orta-konsol-d-zenleyici.baski: I used .15 layer height for the poles and center wall so they slide together a bit easier. With the other walls laying on the flared spine to print, they will slide in easier if you wanted to try and bump up the layer height more. Also used PETG since it withstands higher temps

22re-motor-bujisi-ve-k-r-k-tak-m-tpu.baski: They are redesigned to printed in TPU and press fit into the head. Spark plugs must use a brim for printing

toyota-tundra-telefon-tutucu.baski: Sized to fit a OnePlus 6 with slim TPU case that came with the phone.

2014-2020-toyota-tundra-n-panel-telefon-.baski: Suggest to print with ABS so it won't melt in your truck

2022-toyota-tundra-bardakl-k-aralay-c.baski: This is printed in PLA but you can use anything... will probably be even better printed in TPU/Flex, which I plan to try.

toyota-4runner-izgara-klipsleri.baski: I used matter hacker black pla and used prusa slicer for gcode I used 100% infill

toyota-sienna-koltuk-arkas-bardak-termos.baski: I printed this in PLA and have been using it in the van for about a month and a half. If you are concerned, print it in TPU or PETG for higher heat resistance.

toyota-tacoma-emniyet-kemeri-tutucu-tek-.baski: I printed this in PETG to better handle hot temps inside the truck when parked.

2010-toyota-rav4-telefon-tutucu.baski: Don't use PLA for printing if you live a hot climate.

toyota-gr-yaris-kol-dayana.baski: - Outer walls/perimeters: at least 3 - Layer height: 0.3mm (it takes a looooot of hours to print all parts even at that height) - Infill: 15-20% works fine

10-vida-i-in-9-9-kare-plastik-somun.baski: These are best printed in nylon.

2-nesil-toyota-tacoma-bardakl-k-aparat.baski: I created this based on the idea found I believe from the 4Runner's and adopted it to work with my 2nd Gen Tacoma (2009.) I built using PLA at 0.2mm layer height and it looks great.

toyota-buton-bo-lu-u-kapa.baski: 20% infill. Printed in black PETG. no support needed.

i-klips-i-in-yenilenen-pim-toyota.baski: I printed in flexible filament. I think this change will only be good if you can print flexible material.

2009-toyota-tacoma-bardakl-k-adapt-r.baski: It uses about 300 g of filament and needs a 210mm x 105mm x 80mm bed it does not like scaling of obvious reasons.

nissan-titan-arka-kapak-burcu-toyota-uyu.baski: This is the left side tailgate bushing for a 2012 Nissan Titan I've only tested with ABS and PLA and found that ABS works better. It might work better with other materials like PETG. make sure to print with 100% infill, this part has to be durable enough for the tailgate to open and close over and over again.

toyota-prius-paspas-klipsi.baski: Any filament type would probably work but I used PETG filament because it's fairly resistant to warping in the high temperatures that cars can reach in the summer. I printed with draft quality resolution and 100% infill. (On its side with the three small anti-slip pins on the bottom.) No rafts or support needed.

gr-yaris-telefon-klipsi.baski: Printed in Prusa ASA as high glass temp and UV stable.

2003-toyota-corolla-aksesuar-buton-kapa.baski: I suggest using a stronger filament for this print because how widely car temperatures vary.

toyota-auris-telefon-tutucu.baski: I printed PLA+ with a Anycubic Kobra.

toyota-celica-6-nesil-kaput-dayanak-tutu.baski: Printed in PETG at 240C nozzle and 85C bed on my ender 3. Print as is with supports.

hpi-venture-arka-destek-par-as.baski: i printed this at 0.3 res and %10 infill , no need for support

toyota-highlander-cep-telefonu-tutucu.baski: Printed it PETG to minimize impact from sun and heat.

toyota-tacoma-klima-hava-y-nlendirici-ha.baski: Made from PLA or PETG and both seem about the same. PLA may warp or fade over time.

toyota-1998-hoparl-r-adapt-r.baski: Recommend printing with high temp filament (ABS, PETG, etc.) Printed on Bambu X1 Carbon 100% infill Supports required.

toyota-fren-pedal-anahtar-durdurucu-ve-d.baski: use tpu or petg or abs but I strongly recommend tpu. make sure infill is 100% and 2 walls

toyota-easy-to-install-car-havaland-rma-.baski: I tested it with my Creality LD-002R (resin) and with my XYZ Da Vinci (PLA). The PLA print in my case required some quick post-processing with a drill.

toyota-land-cruiser-fj60-fren-debriyaj-p.baski: It's a near exact copy of the design of the stock part, however I decreased the size of the lip used to hold it onto the pedal due to the stiffness of my TPU. I think I used 90a TPU but your mileage may vary.

toyota-tacoma-4runner-tutama-diz-st-bilg.baski: For optimal durability and heat resistance in a vehicle environment, it is recommended to print the post and platform components in PETG, ASA, or ABS. ASA, in particular, provides the highest resistance to deformation under these

toyota-tundra-2022-sequoia-2023-konsol-s.baski: however it won't be as durable and possibly heat-resistant, being a hollow box and potentially noisy depending on the tolerances (mine was perfect).
